title: The heavy precipitation event of December 2015 in Chennai, India
publisher: van Oldenborgh et al.; BAMS / WWA
note: No human-caused signal detected for this defined one-day event; this does not disprove climate change or address all flood drivers.

title: Chennai Flood 2015
note: Flood-management resource; full report not reviewed. No numerical local attribution is taken from it.

title: Coastal erosion: NCCR shoreline assessment and hazard-line context
note: Shoreline movement combines natural and human drivers. Historical erosion is not a prediction of future local retreat.

title: Desertification and Land Degradation Atlas collection
note: Remote-sensing screening; field soil and land-use verification required. Full atlas tables not extracted.

title: National Inventory of Sewage Treatment Plants in India
note: Installed capacity, operating capacity and compliant treatment differ. Historical inventory is not today’s plant performance.

title: Wetland maintenance: Jakkur Lake

review: Study design, farmer-perception section and conclusion excerpts
note: Survey and sample analysis across Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Maharashtra; adoption selection and crop differences limit causal inference.

title: Restoration research programme

title: The Grasslands Initiative
